input.china_demand: 《天下3》是网易历时6年，耗资过亿开发的国内第一款绿色免费3D网游，也是网易第一款即时战斗MMORPG。 《天下3》是网易历时6年，耗资过亿开发的国内第一款绿色免费3D网游，也是网易第一款即时战斗MMORPG。它以女娲补天等上古神话故事为背景，以雄关蜀道等中华地理风貌为蓝本，处处充满浓郁的中国元素。玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。在《天下3》构建的虚拟社区中，玩家或标新立异不同凡响，或行侠仗义行走江湖，或号令众人攻城夺寨。 发展至今，《天下3》游戏中已经有了十一大门派，完善平衡的门派阵容和各具特色的技能搭配为玩家提供了丰富多样的玩法乐趣，各个门派兴衰历史、辗转起伏的往昔故事令人震撼、叹为观止。《天下3》的主线故事剧情格局恢弘、叙事连贯，玩家对在玩游戏时体验到的爱恨情仇、缘起缘灭，无不感到震撼非凡。而在玩法方面，玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。 除了恢弘的背景设定和优秀的玩法内容，《天下3》作为一款国风幻想3D游戏，其超强的3D美术设计和游戏内音乐制作在业界一直都位于顶尖最领先水平：场景真实，色调统一而不单调，显得场面格局整体和谐、气势磅礴一贯而终；整体配乐恢宏大气，极具感染力。 14年来，《天下3》凭借独特的山海国风美术、优秀的剧情塑造、爽快的PVP体验等，持续塑造一个史诗的国风大世界，甚至是顶级品质游戏IP，同时也赢得了许多品牌荣誉：中国民族网络游戏出版工程、百度风云玄幻网游、迅雷网游下载榜冠军、腾讯年度十大最受欢迎网游、净网先锋网吧最具人气奖、17173十大最受欢迎网络游戏、2012、2013、2014年度最佳运营奖、网吧最受欢迎3D游戏、最具人气网络游戏、2015年度中国网络文化风云榜风云产品、2016年金浪奖、17173游戏风云榜名游堂、2019年度中国游戏行业“金手指奖”以及2018年度中国游戏行业“优秀网络游戏”奖。 《天下3》是网易历时6年，耗资过亿开发的国内第一款绿色免费3D网游，也是网易第一款即时战斗MMORPG。它以女娲补天等上古神话故事为背景，以雄关蜀道等中华地理风貌为蓝本，处处充满浓郁的中国元素。玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。在《天下3》构建的虚拟社区中，玩家或标新立异不同凡响，或行侠仗义行走江湖，或号令众人攻城夺寨。 发展至今，《天下3》游戏中已经有了十一大门派，完善平衡的门派阵容和各具特色的技能搭配为玩家提供了丰富多样的玩法乐趣，各个门派兴衰历史、辗转起伏的往昔故事令人震撼、叹为观止。《天下3》的主线故事剧情格局恢弘、叙事连贯，玩家对在玩游戏时体验到的爱恨情仇、缘起缘灭，无不感到震撼非凡。而在玩法方面，玩家在游戏中，可以体验灵兽养成、元魂幻化等中国特色的创新玩法，并领略以中华副本和野外Boss为特点的PVE玩法以及以战场、势力战、城战为代表的PVP玩法。 除了恢弘的背景设定和优秀的玩法内容，《天下3》作为一款国风幻想3D游戏，其超强的3D美术设计和游戏内音乐制作在业界一直都位于顶尖最领先水平：场景真实，色调统一而不单调，显得场面格局整体和谐、气势磅礴一贯而终；整体配乐恢宏大气，极具感染力。 14年来，《天下3》凭借独特的山海国风美术、优秀的剧情塑造、爽快的PVP体验等，持续塑造一个史诗的国风大世界，甚至是顶级品质游戏IP，同时也赢得了许多品牌荣誉：中国民族网络游戏出版工程、百度风云玄幻网游、迅雷网游下载榜冠军、腾讯年度十大最受欢迎网游、净网先锋网吧最具人气奖、17173十大最受欢迎网络游戏、2012、2013、2014年度最佳运营奖、网吧最受欢迎3D游戏、最具人气网络游戏、2015年度中国网络文化风云榜风云产品、2016年金浪奖、17173游戏风云榜名游堂、2019年度中国游戏行业“金手指奖”以及2018年度中国游戏行业“优秀网络游戏”奖。 Simplified Chinese * * languages with full audio support

input.china_demand: Main Sequence is a first-person space-sim factory builder where you design spaceships, build space stations, and automate everything. Start with a single ship and grow to become an interstellar industrial empire as you leave your mark on the galaxy. Join our Community About the Game You are at the frontier of human-charted space in a small mining ship, tasked with expanding humanity's footprint amongst the stars. To succeed, you’ll need to collect resources, automate production, expand your base of operations, and research new technologies. You start out with a single mining ship in a resource-rich asteroid belt. Use your scanners to find the best places to mine, and then refine the resources on your ship. Build a space station to set up a permanent base of operations which you can begin to expand and automate. Onboard your stations, the factories you build are the heart of your industrial operation . Build machines, connect them with conveyor belts, and plan your production lines to keep everything flowing at full efficiency. Once that's running, that same logic extends across systems - automated supply routes between stations , and a fleet that keeps everything provisioned while you focus on expanding your operations. Every ship and station is yours to design, inside and out . Module by module, you decide cargo capacity, reactor placement and weapons - whatever the situation calls for. Save designs to use again, share them with friends, or build freely in creative mode. You'll need those weapons. Your industrial activity has woken something up - an ancient alien defence network that's identified you as a threat . Use your fleet to protect what you've built, or take the fight to them before the next wave arrives. Research new technology with the items you produce. Each unlock opens up new ships, station modules, items and upgrades - everything you need to push further out. You will need to expand your industrial operations into new frontiers, but each new area will bring its own challenges and enemies to overcome. Use all of the tools at your disposal to build the ultimate battleship capable of handling any threat on your path to victory. Venture into the unknown, with each procedurally generated star system offering unique logistic challenges to overcome. Explore wrecks, find new resources, and discover stellar phenomena such as black holes and neutron stars . Play solo, or in co-op where each player is the captain of their own ship . Divide responsibilities however you like - one on logistics, another on defence, another out exploring - or work side by side on the same objective. Co-op opens up what’s possible. The bigger the crew, the bigger the empire. input.china_demand: Dawn is an animated film that plunges you into the heart of a dark story. A fighter pilot, ready to do anything for revenge. An explosive cocktail of dogfights, epic music and a gripping story. Out on Steam November 10, 2026. Dawn Aerowar is an interactive animated film. It blends 3D animation, 2D art and full voice acting to tell the story of a fighter pilot on his final mission, driven by revenge against the Empire that took everything from him. Press Play and you are in the War Room: a war map of the whole operation, twelve missions along one route. The next sortie is marked. You launch it from the map. Then the episode plays in full, without interruption. He escorts a weapon no one should know exists. All that stands in his way are the aces of the Saal'Runa Empire, the last pilots standing after years of war. The film runs nearly two hours, mixing aerial combat and drama. Dawn is a story made and composed by veterans of the genre: a man on a mission, and what it would take to stop him. In a world scarred by years of war, the Free Nations stand on the brink of annihilation. With an iron fist, the Saal'Runa Empire has crushed every resistance but one. One pilot flies one last sortie across the whole Empire: the northern front, the strait, the Aegis Sea, the Capital. Patrols chase him and missiles fan out over the clouds. Every flight is staged and animated in 3D, then framed like a film. Faces, hands and cockpits are all hand drawn. Zodiac 1 lost everything to the Empire: his family, his home, his purpose. All he has left is one burning drive: revenge. Along the way, Zodiac will face many enemies, in the air, at sea and on land. But three of them are especially formidable: the three Aces of the Empire. Reaper , the Name of Death, loves war more than peace. Freya , the Imperial Goddess, quotes philosophers in the middle of a dogfight. Miracle , the Guardian Angel, is known for the lives she saved rather than the ones she took. Each of them asks Zodiac the same thing: do you even know what you're fighting for? Zodiac flies alone. The war reaches him only through the cockpit radio, from an AWACS operator he has never heard before. She is talkative, sharp and strangely well informed. A professional voice cast : Sam Hughes, Kira Buckland, Lara Sawalha, Blythe Melin, Sandra Espinoza, Mark Mullens, Jeremiah Foltz, and over thirty additional voices. Every word and every emotion is performed. The soundtrack is fully original and composed to picture : orchestral, fast-paced and epic, with choirs, Bulgarian voices and classical guitar, plus two original songs. Written by Jose Pavli, the composer of Project Wingman, it runs 77 minutes. Dawn runs in its own app, with subtitles and Steam achievements. The film has 12 episodes and runs nearly two hours. Subtitles are available in English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Russian and Brazilian Portuguese. The film was 186% funded on Kickstarter by more than 600 backers. A map lets you follow the progress of Zodiac's mission. After each episode, you can open a dossier with information on the places and characters you have encountered. This War Room expands the lore and helps you understand the story in more detail, in case anything slipped past you. If you prefer, Cinema mode lets you watch the film in one sitting: the 12 episodes play back to back without interruption, and you can return to the War Room afterwards. Recreate the vast history of the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period You will be in the ever-changing situation of the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period, and personally experience the complex world full of intrigues, wars and alliances. Fight side by side with historical generals and participate in the struggle between hundreds of vassal states. Every decision you make will affect the future of this land. Here, you can choose to be the ruler of a powerful empire and hold great power, or an ordinary nobleman, relying on wisdom and courage to fight for a place in the chaos. From the rise and fall of the family to the vertical and horizontal of the countries, every dispute is full of power and life and death behind it. Manage the family and develop the country, you will become a part of history. This is a war of blood and fire, and also a contest of courage and wisdom. Huge and detailed strategic map The strategic map at the core of the game truly restores the geographical features of the Eastern Zhou Dynasty. From the great rivers to the continuous mountains, from the prosperous cities to the remote borders, you will strategize and confront on this vast land. Hundreds of cities and no data points constitute this battlefield full of opportunities and challenges. The ups and downs of mountains and rivers, the direction of rivers, and the smoothness of roads will all become important factors in strategic decision-making. Famous passes such as Mount Xiao and Hangu are places of contention for military strategists, and dynamic seasonal changes will also directly affect military operations. input.china_demand: Build and lead a colony on the surface of an endless Wall. Manage resources and your people, develop new technologies, defend against relentless zyrex attacks, and send robo-spiders on risky expeditions. Keep the colony from collapsing – in Wall World, it's easy to fall. The Wall is a colossal structure stretching far beyond the visible horizon, hiding traces of ancient eras and unexplained phenomena within its depths. Here, among stone, metal, and darkness, humanity has been forced to build a new life – clinging to the Wall and trying to survive in a world full of threats and mysteries. Wall World Strategy is a colony sim on a sheer vertical surface, where every decision affects the stability of the system. Build and expand your base, gather resources, take care of your people, strengthen your defenses, and send expeditions into distant regions and unexplored depths. Each new step forward brings not only opportunities for growth but also new dangers. Survival depends on your foresight, your ability to manage limited resources, and your willingness to make difficult decisions. BUILD AND EXPAND THE COLONY Establish a base on the surface of the Endless Wall and gradually turn a small outpost into a large, stable, and well-defended colony. Plan the placement of key structures, develop production chains, expand living areas, and build infrastructure capable of supporting both population growth and stable operations. As your colony grows, you will need to decide how to expand, which structures to prioritize, and where to allocate resources – whether into production, housing, or defense. WITHSTAND THE THREATS The Wall is far from lifeless. In its shadows lurk zyrexes – dangerous creatures that will attack your colony again and again, testing its defenses, organization, and your ability to respond. Strengthen your defenses, secure vulnerable areas, and decide how much you can afford to invest in protection. Additional pressure comes from emergency events such as accidents, disasters, and environmental hazards. They won't destroy your colony instantly, but they will disrupt its operations and trigger cascading problems. MANAGE YOUR SOCIETY Your colony is, above all, made up of people – living, working, hoping for the future, and depending on your decisions. Monitor their condition and take into account how they react to your choices. Overpopulation, food shortages, or supply disruptions can quickly lead to declining efficiency, crisis, and riots. Caring for your people is a core part of the strategy. The state of your population determines the performance of the entire colony – its productivity and its ability to endure prolonged periods of danger. A strong and well-supported society recovers faster from attacks and moves forward with greater confidence. GATHER RESOURCES AND ADVANCE Start with basic resource extraction and gradually build a more complex economy. Explore the depths of the Wall, search for stable resource deposits, and develop the infrastructure needed to use them efficiently. Technological progress allows you to improve core systems and unlock new possibilities. Enhance resource gathering and processing, reduce costs, increase efficiency, and strengthen your colony against external threats. Some technologies accelerate infrastructure development, others improve defense, automate key processes, or expand your ability to explore new areas of the Wall. SEND OUT EXPEDITIONS To explore beyond your colony, deploy robo-spiders – specialized machines designed for scouting, resource extraction, and operations in remote areas. Send them into uncharted sectors of the Wall to expand your reach, gather resources, uncover rare discoveries, and explore areas that are too dangerous or inaccessible for humans. However, distant regions bring not only opportunities but also risks. Expeditions may encounter hostile environments, unstable terrain, unknown lifeforms, or remnants of ancient machinery whose purpose has long been forgotten. Prepare your equipment, assess the risks, and decide how far you're willing to go. EXPLORE THE DEPTHS OF THE WALL The Wall is more than just the surface your colony clings to. Beneath it lies an entire world filled with resources, forgotten technologies, and rare artifacts. Extract valuable materials, recover technological samples that can accelerate your development, and uncover unique objects that help you understand this world. As you explore, you will begin to find answers – but each discovery raises new questions about the nature of the Wall and why it became humanity's last refuge. PLAY BY YOUR OWN RULES Develop your colony in Sandbox Mode without story constraints or time pressure. Choose from different maps and difficulty levels, tailor the conditions to your liking, and keep playing for as long as you want. Zyrexes will still attack, but you can play at your own pace and experiment with different development and defense strategies. input.china_demand: Your enemies are numbers. Your weapons are math. Reduce them all to zero. A twin-stick shooter roguelite where you subtract, divide, root and modulo your way through angry digits. Tuned to your skill level, from basic arithmetic to advanced operations. You failed math class. Math didn't forget. Zero Sum is a pencil-on-paper twin-stick shooter roguelite. Your enemies are numbers and your weapon is math. No health bars. No hit points. Just raw arithmetic violence. A "48" is charging at you. You fire ÷2. Now it's "24". Three more divisions: "12," "6," "3." Now switch to minus. Bang. Bang. Bang. Zero. Gone. Next. Wishlist now! The numbers are counting on you not to. Fight through different difficulties and game modes with a variety of arithmetic weapons. Face 9 different bosses based around mathematical concepts. Fine-tune your experience to your math knowledge level , from subtraction and addition, to division and multiplication, up to root and modulo. Enemies aren't just walking health bars. A prime number can't be cleanly divided. A factorial grows exponentially if you ignore it. Negatives force you to rethink. You can't outrun fast enemies. Don't just shoot, solve. Forget guns. You carry operators . Minus and Plus are your reliable sidearms. Precise but boring, until they save your life. Division rips through enemies. Root turns big numbers into rubble. Modulo nukes even the biggest numbers if played right. Multiplication ? A slow trap that slows everything it touches. Useful if you're smart enough to set up a kill with it. And then there's Sigma , turn a massive swarm of numbers into one big, easy-to-handle target. Seven operators. Twenty-two firing modes to unlock. Every shot requires a decision. Every clean kill and clever combo rewards bonus points. Integer split, perfect root, modulo blast. The game knows when you're showing off and rewards you for it. Every kill can be a clean kill. Divide a number into a perfect split. Root a perfect square down. Land a modulo that leaves exactly zero. The game tracks your math and rewards precision. Chain multiple clean kills for combo multipliers. Perfect wave? No misses? Bonus points. String together operations across different operators for Clean Combo Chains. The flashier the math, the better the reward. Sloppy kills still work, but clean kills let you progress faster and score higher. In Zero Sum, showing off pays off. Run one, you're rationing division ammo. Do you minus this 72 down shot by shot, or use your division for the perfect clean kill? Do you root the cluster of 16s for instant clears, or hold it for the tanky 256 barreling toward you? Run twenty, your chain-divides ricochet through swarms, your root shotgun pulps clusters in a single shot and your Sigma vortex eats half the screen. Permanent upgrades carry between runs. Temporary buffs stack within them. Every death makes the next run meaner. Standard Mode is the core roguelite loop. Chain smart math, build combos, aim for Perfect Waves, and fight through bosses. Die, learn, upgrade, repeat. Verdict Mode is a precision test. Each enemy requires exactly one correct operation — ÷, √, or %. A clean solve removes the number instantly. A wrong answer triggers consequences defined by the challenge author. No second chances. No spray-and-pray. Target Mode flips the script. Instead of reducing enemies to zero, you must transform each number into a specific target using +, × and Σ within a limited number of operations. A built-in reachability solver monitors every enemy in real time and flags impossible states on the spot, so if you're stuck, you know it's your math, not the puzzle. Zero Sum includes a fully customizable in-game challenge editor. Design custom math puzzles with your own wave sequences, enemy spawns, operator loadouts, traps, and resolution rules. Built-in validation catches unsolvable configurations before you export. Every problem set compresses into a compact share code. Copy it, paste it, send it to a friend, drop it in chat, post it online. Anyone can play your challenge, get graded on a Report Card and send their results back to you as a code. Set your own grade thresholds, write your own teacher name, add custom per-grade comments. Build challenges for your friends, your community, your viewers or for a classroom. The tools don't care who's playing. They just grade. Nine bosses, each built around a mathematical concept that wants you dead (a small selection): The Euler Owl a wise creature, firing Taylor series bullets that duplicate. Deal with them before the expansion overwhelms you. The Factorial Factory a stationary boss that launches factorial projectiles. 9! explodes into 9 × 8 × 7 × 6 × …, trying to recombine into their product. Reduce the pieces to zero before they merge. The Pi Boss a pie protected by digits. Each slice of pi must be dealt with to turn armor into weak points. The Yin-Yang Boss two spinning halves, one light, one dark. Focus too much on one half and the other goes berserk. Balance the harmony meter or get swarmed. The Prime Sieve Spider an eight-legged boss whose web is the Sieve of Eratosthenes. Identify and destroy the composites while avoiding prime traps. Hit a prime and it breaks free to chase you. Clear the web to expose a leg joint. Fail, and the entire web turns into a swarm. Zero Sum looks like your notebook came alive and got angry. Enemies are the doodles you drew when you were bored in math class. Except these doodles want revenge. Every menu is a school handout — quitting the game requires a permission slip. 7 operator weapons with 22 firing modes : every operator unlocks three to four distinct modes that change their behavior and your playstyle 100+ upgrade nodes across the operator tree: chain division, shotgun roots, area-of-effect modulo blasts, freeze lines, Sigma vortexes and more 9 boss fights built around real mathematical concepts: exponentials, prime sieves, pi, harmonic balance, factorials and more 3 game modes : Standard roguelite runs, Verdict precision challenges, and Target puzzle combat — each with unique operators, rules, and scoring Full challenge editor : design custom problem sets with wave sequences, operator loadouts, traps, and grading rules. input.china_demand: Welcome to Chinese Board & Card Games Museum. Step back into 1980s–90s China and play Dou Di Zhu, Guandan, Sichuan Mahjong, Ka Wu Xing, and more in 3D hometown scenes lit by your own clock. Practice against AI and rewind any move. Buy once, no ads. Welcome to Chinese Board & Card Games Museum Step back with us into the streets and courtyards of 1980s and 1990s China, where regional card and mahjong tables from across the country are gathered into one playable museum. Across China, the same deck of cards or set of mahjong tiles takes on different rules, names, and rhythms from one city to the next. Here, clear rulesets, cultural exhibits, and smooth tabletop matches live side by side. There is no required reading before you play—feel free to look around, sit down to a game you grew up with, or read an exhibit label and discover a game from another region. Every way to play has a hometown Inside the museum, we have recreated the local setting where each game grew up. Pull up a chair at any table, and you step right into the daily life of that city: Head to a Wuhan alley on a summer night to play Dou Di Zhu in the evening breeze; Visit a canal-side home in Huai'an for a partnership round of Guandan; Climb to an autumn rooftop in Changsha and race to empty your hand in Pao De Kuai; Step inside a Xiaogan main hall in winter to play Ka Wu Xing behind closed doors; Sit down in an early-spring Chengdu teahouse to play Sichuan Mahjong to the last tile; Or stay right by the Eight-Immortals table in the center of our museum hall for a game of Sheng Ji, played all across China. The lighting in these old streets follows your computer’s clock—lamps come on at dusk, and a midnight game means midnight outside the window too. Clear skies, rain, snow, or fog: you choose. Take a breather and the camera wanders the city for you. Prefer to focus purely on the cards? Switch to Simple Mode anytime to skip the 3D scenes and go straight to the table. Misplayed? Play it again Every move against the AI is recorded. Step back to any move, play it differently, and the game branches from there. The original line is kept, so you can switch back and compare at any time. Available in all six games. Branching sessions are for practice and do not count toward your match record. A quiet table We want to give you a quiet place to play. Buy once: no ads, no top-ups, nothing nudging you along. Guandan and Sheng Ji also include guided lessons, and Sheng Ji comes with a built-in card tracker. More exhibits on the way The free demo currently offers six games—Dou Di Zhu, Guandan, Pao De Kuai, Sheng Ji, Sichuan Mahjong, and Ka Wu Xing—all supporting Steam friend rooms (in testing). Early Access is planned for Q4 2026 and will continue to welcome more regional games beyond these six, with the initial lineup announced at launch. Every game has a history Beside every table is an exhibit story and a lineage tree. Every branch on the tree cites its historical source; where accounts disagree, we draw the line dashed. Each table also states the exact ruleset adopted in the museum. House rules vary wildly from town to town—if yours differ, come tell us in the discussions. Local rules are the collection this museum treasures most. A growing museum Yandra Studio is building this museum piece by piece. More regional games and rulesets will keep arriving, and each one is placed on display only once it plays smoothly and its story can be told properly. Available on Windows with mouse and keyboard controls. No controller support yet. Switch between Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English in the game without restarting your match. Traditional Chinese uses Chinese audio. Pull up a chair at any table, and you step right into the daily life of that city: Head to a Wuhan alley on a summer night to play Dou Di Zhu in the evening breeze; Visit a canal-side home in Huai'an for a partnership round of Guandan; Climb to an autumn rooftop in Changsha and race to empty your hand in Pao De Kuai; Step inside a Xiaogan main hall in winter to play Ka Wu Xing behind closed doors; Sit down in an early-spring Chengdu teahouse to play Sichuan Mahjong to the last tile; Or stay right by the Eight-Immortals table in the center of our museum hall for a game of Sheng Ji, played all across China. The lighting in these old streets follows your computer’s clock—lamps come on at dusk, and a midnight game means midnight outside the window too. Clear skies, rain, snow, or fog: you choose. Take a breather and the camera wanders the city for you. Prefer to focus purely on the cards? Switch to Simple Mode anytime to skip the 3D scenes and go straight to the table. Misplayed? Play it again Every move against the AI is recorded. Step back to any move, play it differently, and the game branches from there. The original line is kept, so you can switch back and compare at any time. Available in all six games. Branching sessions are for practice and do not count toward your match record. A quiet table We want to give you a quiet place to play. Buy once: no ads, no top-ups, nothing nudging you along. Guandan and Sheng Ji also include guided lessons, and Sheng Ji comes with a built-in card tracker. More exhibits on the way The free demo currently offers six games—Dou Di Zhu, Guandan, Pao De Kuai, Sheng Ji, Sichuan Mahjong, and Ka Wu Xing—all supporting Steam friend rooms (in testing). Early Access is planned for Q4 2026 and will continue to welcome more regional games beyond these six, with the initial lineup announced at launch. Every game has a history Beside every table is an exhibit story and a lineage tree. Every branch on the tree cites its historical source; where accounts disagree, we draw the line dashed. Each table also states the exact ruleset adopted in the museum. House rules vary wildly from town to town—if yours differ, come tell us in the discussions. Local rules are the collection this museum treasures most. A growing museum Yandra Studio is building this museum piece by piece. More regional games and rulesets will keep arriving, and each one is placed on display only once it plays smoothly and its story can be told properly. Available on Windows with mouse and keyboard controls. No controller support yet. Switch between Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English in the game without restarting your match. Traditional Chinese uses Chinese audio. Simplified Chinese * , English, Traditional Chinese * languages with full audio support

china_opportunities.value: Starting with a table and a computer, create videos, build a following, secure brand collaborations, engage in live-streaming e-commerce, and assemble a team to ultimately establish your own media empire. Experience the journey of a content creator from obscurity to industry leadership! 关于这款游戏 从一名默默无闻的创作者开始，打造属于你的内容帝国。 《流量时代（Creator Era）》是一款像素风模拟经营游戏。 从零开始，你将踏入内容创作行业，选择属于自己的发展方向，拍摄视频、积累粉丝、打造爆款内容，与品牌合作、直播带货、组建团队，最终建立属于自己的传媒公司，成为影响千万人的顶级创作者。 每一次选题、每一次发布、每一次商业决策，都将改变你的创作生涯。 你，能否成为下一个时代传奇？ 🎥 从零开始创作 从一间小房间、一张桌子、一台电脑开始。 选择视频题材，策划内容，拍摄、剪辑、发布。 不同的内容方向拥有不同的发展路线。 数码 游戏 科技 汽车 美食 动画 搞笑 知识科普 Vlog 摄影 旅行 健身 美妆 宠物 音乐 更多创作领域…… 寻找热点，把握趋势，制作真正能够爆火的视频。 📈 数据决定一切 每一条视频都会实时产生数据。 观察你的： 播放量 点赞 收藏 评论 弹幕 转发 粉丝增长 热度趋势 收益变化 研究数据，调整创作方向，打造属于自己的爆款公式。 🤝 接受商业合作 input.china_demand: A stylish roguelike deckbuilder where two heroes fight as one. Weave cross-combos, parry to hold the line, and unleash Unison finishers as you sail a collapsing multiverse — retreading a fixed fate, again and again, to gather the Echoes of a lost truth. NEOVERSE 2 is a stylish roguelike deckbuilder built around a single idea: a pair is stronger than the sum of two heroes . Pick two of several heroes, share one deck, and fight in a timeline where every card you play sets up the one your partner plays next. When Resonance peaks, trigger Unison and end the fight with a finisher only your pair can perform. Combo — chain cards across both heroes to build Resonance and unlock Unison. Parry — read the enemy's intent and match it exactly to turn damage into momentum. Tempo — every turn of the battle runs on the timeline. Push, pull and swap turns to steal the rhythm. Naya overheats her weapons until they burst. Claire balances faith and bloodlust. Helena commands three beasts. Lucy, a new hero, wields multiple weapons and manipulates the timeline. Every pair plays differently, and every pair has its own Unison finisher. Power in NEOVERSE 2 comes from Echoes : fragments of lost timelines you fit into a limited budget. Build around a pair, not a character. Rebuild it between every fight. Chart a branching course across seven worlds — Terra, Pantheon, Nocturne, Cogito, Mirage, Requiem and the Nameless — each with its own residents, threats and a boss that remembers you. Cross the Transcendence Gate and venture into the deeper abyss. The truth is scattered across Echoes, events, cards and the things your partner says when you both survive. Retread the same orbit run after run, and the pieces, like severed time, meet again and join. Experience explosive synergy born from your choices, your focus — and a little luck. New pairs, new Starting Decks, a single Echo, a single card — each one makes a new battle. The joy of choosing keeps you looking forward to what comes next.
